authority_limit: The study is exploratory and not a universal metric catalog.
lessons_for_composable_platform: Model quality from the consumer/task perspective, not only database validity.
Keep dimensions and fitness policies contextual.
name: Richard Y. Wang

authority_limit: The dimensional framework does not select thresholds or product boundaries.
lessons_for_composable_platform: Separate intrinsic, contextual, representational and accessibility concerns.
Elicit needs from users before selecting measures.
name: Diane M. Strong

authority_limit: Research systems and monographs do not authorize production corrections.
lessons_for_composable_platform: Separate heterogeneous rule specification from detection and repair execution.
Retain uncertainty and human/authority seams around repair.
name: Ihab F. Ilyas

authority_limit: Probabilistic repair results are corpus and model scoped.
lessons_for_composable_platform: Treat cleaning as multiple method families with different assumptions.
Make candidate evidence and repair provenance first-class.
name: Xu Chu

authority_limit: Inference confidence is not adjudication or source truth.
lessons_for_composable_platform: Combine constraints and statistical evidence without hiding uncertainty.
Expose inference configuration and candidate alternatives.
name: Theodoros Rekatsinas

authority_limit: One probabilistic formulation does not cover every quality defect.
lessons_for_composable_platform: Compile heterogeneous evidence into explicit probabilistic programs.
Separate scalable inference from authority and effects.
name: Christopher Ré

authority_limit: Profiling surveys do not define business truth or acceptance.
lessons_for_composable_platform: Data profiling is a family of discovery problems, not one summary call.
Candidate dependencies and constraints remain hypotheses until accepted.
name: Felix Naumann

authority_limit: Discovery evidence remains data/sample scoped.
lessons_for_composable_platform: Keep profiling tasks, algorithms and discovery guarantees explicit.
Expose completeness and approximation limits.
name: Ziawasch Abedjan

authority_limit: A discovered dependency is not an approved contract.
lessons_for_composable_platform: Treat dependency discovery, inclusion dependencies and uniqueness as distinct kernels.
Retain exact candidate evidence and counterexamples.
name: Thorsten Papenbrock

authority_limit: Reported scalability and checks do not establish universal fitness.
lessons_for_composable_platform: Compile declarative constraints into scalable aggregate verification.
Reuse computed states while preserving analyzer identity and scope.
name: Sebastian Schelter

authority_limit: ML-data validation patterns do not define all enterprise quality semantics.
lessons_for_composable_platform: Separate schema inference, anomaly detection and accepted schema evolution.
Protect training/serving boundaries with explicit data validation.
name: Eric Breck

authority_limit: ADWIN detects bounded distributional change, not cause or defect.
lessons_for_composable_platform: Make adaptive-window assumptions and confidence parameters explicit.
Treat detector resets as state transitions.
name: Albert Bifet

authority_limit: A two-sample test does not diagnose cause or select remediation.
lessons_for_composable_platform: Define the two populations, kernel, test statistic and calibration before claiming shift.
Separate evidence against equality from operational impact.
name: Arthur Gretton

authority_limit: Posterior change probability depends on the chosen generative model.
lessons_for_composable_platform: Represent run length, hazard assumptions and posterior alternatives explicitly.
Keep online evidence distinct from retrospective truth.
name: Ryan Prescott Adams

authority_limit: Forest scores are detector-specific and not universally comparable.
lessons_for_composable_platform: Use streaming anomaly methods with explicit state, score and explanation boundaries.
Do not collapse anomaly score into defect verdict.
name: Sudipto Guha

authority_limit: DQV explicitly does not define one ideal quality model.
lessons_for_composable_platform: Keep dimension, metric, measurement, policy, annotation and certificate distinct.
Bind each measurement to the resource computed on.
name: W3C Data Quality Vocabulary Working Group

authority_limit: ISO catalog pages do not supply industry thresholds or implementation conformance.
lessons_for_composable_platform: Separate quality characteristics from measurement procedures.
Use editioned normative vocabulary inside its scope.
name: ISO/IEC JTC 1/SC 7 SQuaRE community

authority_limit: Metrology uncertainty is not all sampling, model or business uncertainty.
lessons_for_composable_platform: Separate measurand, indication, result, calibration and uncertainty.
Propagate uncertainty through an explicit measurement model.
name: JCGM metrology community

authority_limit: Facets transport evidence; they do not establish truth or complete lineage.
lessons_for_composable_platform: Attach measurements/assertions to exact dataset/run identities.
Keep assertion success separate from configured severity.
name: OpenLineage specification community

authority_limit: Banking supervisory principles are not universal horizontal semantics or implementation proof.
lessons_for_composable_platform: Require explicit ownership, aggregation controls and reconciliation where models differ.
Treat completeness, timeliness, accuracy and adaptability as governed obligations.
name: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision
